result.topic_en: Formula-only notes (numbered 63–67) on integrals from 0 to e^{xi} of logarithms of the modular quantities k, k' and the elliptic integral K (forms like log k', log(2K/π), 2K/π−1, 2kK/π, 2k'K/π−1) with respect to dq/q, each expressed as a series of terms like log 4 cos(px/2)^2, log tg(px/2)^2 or log tg((px+π)/4)^2 with coefficients 1/p or 1/p^2, together with correction terms in brackets (x/2π), apparently fractional parts.
result.transcription:
$+4\pi i\left(\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{9}\left(\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{25}\left(\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)\right)$
63) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} -\log k'\frac{\partial q}{q} = -2\log tg\frac{x}{2}^2-\frac{2}{9}\log tg\left(\frac{3x}{2}\right)^2-\frac{2}{25}\log tg\left(\frac{5x}{2}\right)^2$
$\frac{x}{2\pi}=\frac{m}{n}$ [?] $\quad = -\sum_{-\infty,\infty}\frac{\log tg\left(\frac{px}{2}\right)^2}{p^2}$
64) $\int_0^{e^{xi}} \log\frac{2K}{\pi}\frac{\partial q}{q} = [-2-]\log 4\cos\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)^2+\frac{2}{9}\log 4\cos\frac{3x}{2}^2 \cdots = \sum_{-\infty,\infty}\frac{\log 4\cos\frac{px}{2}^2}{p^2}$
$+4\pi i\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{9}\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{25}\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}\right)$
65) $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\left(\frac{2K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{\partial q}{q} = -2\log 4\sin\frac{x}{2}^2+\frac{2}{3}\log 4\sin\frac{3x}{2}^2-\frac{2}{5}\log 4\sin\left(\frac{5x}{2}\right)^2$
$-4\pi i\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)+\frac{4\pi i}{3}\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac12\right)\cdots$
[-66) $\int_0^{xi}\frac{2kK}{\pi}\partial q$-] $= i\log tg\left(\frac{2x+\pi}{4}\right)^2-\frac{i}{2}\log tg\left(\frac{4x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{i}{3}\log tg\left(\frac{6x+\pi}{4}\right)^2$
$2\pi\left(\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{2\pi}{2}\left(\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{2\pi}{3}\left(\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)$
66) $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\frac{2kK}{\pi}\frac{\partial q}{q} = -2\log tg\frac{x}{4}^2+\frac{2}{3}\log tg\frac{3x}{4}^2-\frac{2}{5}\log tg\frac{5x}{4}^2$
$+4\pi i\left(\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}\right)-\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac12\right)\right)-\frac{4\pi i}{3}\left(\frac{3x}{4\pi}-\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac12\right)$.
[-67) $\int_0^{e^{xi}}$-]
$= 2i\log tg\left(\frac{x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{2i}{3}\log tg\frac{3x+\pi}{4}^2+\frac{2i}{5}\log tg\left(\frac{5x+\pi}{4}\right)^2$
$+4\pi\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac14-\left(\frac{x}{4\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{4\pi}{3}\left(\left(\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{3x}{4\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)$
67) $\int_0^{e^{xi}}\left(\frac{2k'K}{\pi}-1\right)\frac{\partial q}{q} = -2\log 4\cos\frac{x}{2}^2+\frac{2}{3}\log 4\cos\frac{3x}{2}^2-\frac{2}{5}\log 4\cos\frac{5x}{2}^2$
$-4\pi i\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}\right)\quad+\frac{4\pi i}{3}\left(\frac{3x}{2\pi}\right)-\frac{4\pi i}{5}\left(\frac{5x}{2\pi}\right)$
$= -i\log tg\left(\frac{2x+\pi}{4}\right)^2+\frac{i}{2}\log tg\left(\frac{4x+\pi}{4}\right)^2-\frac{i}{3}\log tg\frac{6x+\pi}{4}^2$
$-2\pi\left(\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)+\frac{2\pi}{2}\left(\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac14\right)-\left(\frac{2x}{2\pi}+\frac34\right)\right)$

methods.what: Integral of -log k' along q from 0 to e^{xi} as a series of log tan^2 terms with 1/p^2 coefficients
Summation form of the same series
Integral of log(2K/π) dq/q as series of log 4cos^2 terms plus bracket correction terms
Integral of (2K/π−1) dq/q as series of log 4sin^2 terms with alternating 1/p coefficients
Integral of 2kK/π dq/q as series of log tan^2(px/4) terms
Integral of (2k'K/π−1) dq/q in two forms: log 4cos^2 series and log tan((2px+π)/4)^2 series
